metadata.description: Pre-built goal-based workflows that chain multiple skills in sequence for common development objectives.

workflows.name: Full Code Review
workflows.description: Comprehensive 6-phase code review covering context, quality, security, performance, testing, and final report.
workflows.trigger: When you need a thorough review before merging a feature branch or preparing a release.

workflows.name: Security Audit
workflows.description: End-to-end security assessment covering authentication, dependencies, compliance, and code-level vulnerabilities.
workflows.trigger: Before a production release, compliance audit, or after a security incident.

workflows.name: New Project Setup
workflows.description: Initialize a new project with proper structure, testing, CI/CD, documentation, and containerization.
workflows.trigger: When starting a new project or microservice from scratch.

workflows.name: API Development
workflows.description: Design, build, test, and document an API from requirements to deployment.
workflows.trigger: When designing and implementing a new API or major API revision.

workflows.name: Release Preparation
workflows.description: Prepare a release with full review, version bump, changelog, testing, and documentation updates.
workflows.trigger: When preparing a version release for staging or production.

workflows.name: Legacy Modernization
workflows.description: Assess, plan, and execute a legacy codebase modernization using strangler fig and incremental refactoring.
workflows.trigger: When modernizing a legacy system or migrating to a new architecture.

workflows.name: AI Agent Pipeline
workflows.description: Build an AI agent or RAG system from design through implementation and evaluation.
workflows.trigger: When building an AI agent, RAG pipeline, or LLM-powered application.

workflows.name: Compliance Assessment
workflows.description: Full compliance review across applicable regulatory frameworks with gap analysis and remediation plan.
workflows.trigger: When preparing for an audit, onboarding an enterprise client, or reviewing regulatory readiness.

workflows.name: Test Coverage Boost
workflows.description: Systematically increase test coverage from unit tests through E2E with mutation testing validation.
workflows.trigger: When test coverage is below target or test quality is uncertain.

workflows.name: Production Readiness
workflows.description: Validate that a system is ready for production with observability, security, performance, and resilience checks.
workflows.trigger: Before deploying a new service to production for the first time.
